title: Red Team as Wargame: Structured Adversarial Exercises Borrowed from Military Planning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Structured wargaming methodology for red-teaming addresses reproducibility and rigor, but the impact is on process quality rather than on safety outcomes directly.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running a multi-role wargame exercise requires coordinating multiple participants, which is logistically complex. The comparison against unstructured sessions requires careful experimental design. More organizational than technical complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Requires running multiple structured sessions with different roles, comparing against unstructured baseline, documenting protocol. This is a human-subjects-style experiment that is hard to complete in 30 hours.
